projects.name: Rose / OnlyRose
projects.summary: A Solana NFT marketplace and creator platform combining collections, minting, subscriber content, trading and creator operations.
projects.description: Rose extends beyond a simple NFT gallery into collection creation, mint configuration, marketplace activity, creator channels, paid access, private media, community features and cashier-backed subscription flows.
projects.problem: Creators and NFT projects commonly depend on separate mint sites, marketplaces, subscription tools, chats, payment systems and administrative dashboards that do not share one identity or operating model.
projects.solution: A unified creator and NFT platform with wallet-aware access, collections, minting, marketplace features, subscriber channels, treasury fee handling and administrative controls.
capabilities: Solana wallet and NFT ownership flows
Creator channels, chats, polls and events

projects.name: Forbidden Oasis / WATER
projects.summary: A BNB Chain token and staking ecosystem with flexible and locked vaults, rewards, dividend handling, emergency exits and operating tools.
projects.description: Forbidden Oasis combines the WATER token, vault-based staking, flexible and locked positions, WATER and BNB reward handling, compounding, administrative boundaries, public documentation and supporting calculation tools.
projects.problem: Staking products require consistent accounting across principal, rewards, lock state, expiry, penalties, compounding and dividends while keeping maintenance roles separate from asset-control permissions.
projects.solution: A modular vault and controller architecture with explicit locked and flexible state, defined expiry behaviour, emergency-exit rules, maintenance-only operators and user-facing tools for inspecting outcomes.
capabilities: Expiry movement from locked to flexible

projects.name: Cooking Solana Trading System
projects.summary: A Solana trading and automation system with connected-wallet testing, execution controls, observers, strategies and operational tooling.
projects.description: Cooking Solana brings quoting, execution, automation, persistent transaction observation and user-facing trading workflows into a controlled system with staged validation and recovery-aware releases.
projects.problem: Trading systems can appear correct in the interface while failing through quote handling, wallet sessions, transaction assembly, execution observation, API boundaries or incomplete production controls.
projects.solution: A layered trading system with authenticated access, controlled execution, transaction hardening, persistent observers, strategy modules, diagnostics and repeatable deployment phases.
projects.imageAlt: Cooking Solana Trading System project screen

projects.name: FoxySwap Trade
projects.summary: A configurable swap, routing and bridge platform for hosted applications, project sites and embedded trading experiences.
projects.description: FoxySwap Trade combines wallet connection, token discovery, quoting, route presentation, fee handling, execution and embeddable widget delivery in one configurable platform across EVM and Solana product flows.
projects.problem: Projects often assemble wallet libraries, token catalogues, aggregators, fee logic, embeds and operational tooling as separate pieces without one coherent product or support model.
projects.solution: A managed application, API and widget layer that separates same-chain routing from cross-chain execution while giving projects control over branding, token lists, fees and hosted interfaces.

projects.name: InHaus Universal USDC Cashier
projects.summary: A reusable multichain USDC cashier for deposits, account credits, reservations, settlement, sweeps, withdrawals and reconciliation.
projects.description: The Universal Cashier provides the financial operating layer repeatedly required by games, subscription products, creator platforms and transaction systems. It separates chain watchers, ledgers, execution, reconciliation and the user-facing Banker into controlled services.
projects.problem: Products that hold user credit need reliable deposit detection, internal balances, reserved funds, treasury movement, withdrawals and audit evidence. Rebuilding that financial plumbing inside every product creates inconsistent controls and difficult investigations.
projects.solution: A reusable cashier architecture with per-user deposit accounts, EVM and Solana watchers, available and reserved balances, policy-checked execution, reconciliation workers and a consistent Banker interface.
projects.imageAlt: InHaus Universal USDC Cashier project screen
capabilities: Canonical USDC deposits across EVM and Solana
Available, reserved and settled balance states
Application billing and prize settlement APIs

projects.name: InHaus Auditing Suite
projects.summary: Historical replay, contract and system auditing, blockchain investigation, controlled simulation and evidence-driven fault reproduction.
projects.description: The InHaus Auditing Suite brings historical blockchain replay, smart-contract and business-system auditing, wallet and token forensics, future-state simulation, reconciliation and operational evidence into one controlled investigation environment.
projects.problem: Complex failures rarely exist in one contract or one screen. Evidence can be distributed across blocks, wallets, tokens, application services, workers, permissions, ledgers, deployment state and operator actions.
projects.solution: One investigation suite that reconstructs historical state, replays events deterministically, slows or accelerates time, compares expected and actual outcomes, tests alternative futures and produces evidence-backed remediation paths.
capabilities: Blockchain Time Machine for historical replay
Operational replay for billing, rewards, expiry and settlement
Remediation plans backed by reproducible findings

modules.name: Blockchain Time Machine
modules.description: Historical replay of blocks, transactions, wallets, tokens and contract state.

modules.name: Audit & Investigation
modules.description: Smart-contract, application, ledger and business-system auditing.

modules.name: Wallet & Token Forensics
modules.description: Trace activity, balances, transfers, anomalies and behavioural history.

modules.name: Evidence & Reconciliation
modules.description: Compare expected and actual state, preserve findings and reproduce faults.

modules.name: Operational Replay
modules.description: Replay billing, settlement, rewards, expiry, renewals and administrative actions.

projects.name: InHaus Deploylify
projects.summary: A private control plane for deploying, documenting, enrolling and operating applications across managed nodes and Cloudflare routes.
projects.description: Deploylify manages projects, deployment packages, previews, tunnels, documentation and remote node enrolment from a controlled interface. It is an InHaus Technologies product, not the business identity.
projects.problem: Managing many applications across local machines, servers, containers, routes, backups and documentation becomes inconsistent when every project uses one-off deployment steps.
projects.solution: A private deployment control plane with repeatable project releases, standalone node enrolment, health checks, previews, documentation management, versioning and recovery-aware operations.

projects.name: Memopoly
projects.summary: A server-authoritative multiplayer crypto property strategy game with persistent rooms, accounts, Banker balances, staked play and settlement.
projects.description: Memopoly implements a complete 40-space property-board economy with lobbies, reconnects, trades, auctions, cards, buildings, bankruptcy, history, administration and independent EVM and Solana funded-play systems.
projects.problem: A real multiplayer board game requires authoritative rules, concurrent state, reconnect behaviour, financial reservations, settlement, account security and operational controls beyond the board interface.
projects.solution: A tested server-authoritative game engine with persistent rooms and accounts, responsive board interfaces, protected Banker flows and separate EVM and Solana product deployments.
capabilities: Multiplayer rooms, lobby and reconnect flows
Trading, auctions, buildings, cards and bankruptcy
Free Play and funded Staked Play modes
Reserved seat funds and winner settlement
Hall of Fame, history and protected admin tools

projects.name: Deal or No Deal
projects.summary: A community game platform with animated case play, Banker offers, accounts, leaderboards, wallet sessions, sound and Telegram integration.
projects.description: The Deal or No Deal system turns the game-show format into a responsive application with case state, offer logic, account sessions, wallet and Telegram identity, cashier access, administration and a dedicated live-game stage.
projects.problem: A convincing game-show product needs coordinated animation, sound, game state, offer calculations, identity, balances and responsive layouts across desktop and mobile.
projects.solution: A purpose-built game interface and service layer with a clear game stage, Banker workflow, reusable account systems, leaderboard state and community entry paths.
projects.imageAlt: Deal or No Deal project screen

projects.name: Dual-Chain Roulette / Spin & Win
projects.summary: A dual-chain roulette and spin platform with real-time rounds, bet validation, wallet-aware play, settlement and operator controls.
projects.description: The roulette system combines a live wheel and betting table with server-controlled rounds, player balances, chain-aware payment paths, result settlement, history and administrative operations.
projects.problem: Roulette requires synchronized timers, locked betting windows, authoritative outcomes, exact settlement, reconnect behaviour and a presentation that remains readable during live rounds.
projects.solution: A real-time game system separating visual wheel animation from authoritative round state, bet validation, settlement and operational controls across supported chain environments.
projects.imageAlt: Dual-Chain Roulette / Spin & Win project screen
